mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 4.0%, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300 and RSAFS > 700000, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) signals the central bank's likely monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 310, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals an economic contraction, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 102.0 and UNRATE > 4.0, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units signals strong housing market activity and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1400, SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.
